purpose: Test whether the production RossFast top-flux admission boundary is sharp and fail-closed while retaining candidate-independent scientific discrepancy assessment immediately inside and at the boundary.

boundary_axis.derivation: Production internal top reference is +0.01*K with +/-0.02*K envelope; solver-seam request sign is inverted, giving exact request-side upper boundary +0.01*K for the tested states.
boundary_axis.scale_floor_check: P2E16 reconciliation confirmed K > 1e-12 cm/day for every tested material-state pair, so the max(K,1e-12) floor is inactive in this matrix.

matrix.materials: all 36 D3R materials B01-B18 and O01-O18
matrix.case_order: material major, then effective_saturation, then boundary label

primary_endpoints.route_boundary_match: For INSIDE/BOUNDARY RossFast must be route-valid; for OUTSIDE RossFast must fail closed while Reference remains route-valid.
primary_endpoints.admitted_scientific_accuracy: For route-valid INSIDE/BOUNDARY pairs, all five discrepancies must be <= frozen exact-Se P2E16 thresholds.
primary_endpoints.fail_closed: OUTSIDE must not publish a RossFast converged route, must not fallback to Reference, and must not be converted to a discrepancy or performance observation.

known_information_boundary.INSIDE_0p009: No publication-oriented RossFast outcome inspected before P2E16/P2E17 preregistration.
known_information_boundary.BOUNDARY_0p010: Related nominal cases were already observed in P2E10/P2E15; treat as continuity plus exact-boundary evidence, not untouched holdout.
known_information_boundary.OUTSIDE_0p011: No publication-oriented RossFast outcome inspected before P2E16/P2E17 preregistration.
known_information_boundary.prior_WETTING: P2E10 observed a farther-out +0.025*K request as RossFast-invalid; P2E17 tests whether rejection begins immediately beyond +0.010*K rather than only at a distant stress point.
